{{Beta content}}
'''Queen''' is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in {{2|Glory}}. She fights alongside the {{M2|Torch Head Amalgam}}.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Queen}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Puppet Strings
|Intent = CardDebuff
|Effect = Applies 3 {{BD2|Chains of Binding}} to all players.
|GivesToPlayer = Chains of Binding
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = You're Mine
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 99 {{BD2|Frail}}, 99 {{BD2|Weak}}, and 99 {{BD2|Vulnerable}} to all players.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail, Weak, Vulnerable
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Burn Bright for Me
|Intent = Buff, Defend
|Effect = Gives 1 {{BD2|Strength}} to {{M2|Torch Head Amalgam}}. Gains 20 {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength, Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Off with Your Head
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (3;{{Asc2|9|4}}) damage x5.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Execution
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (15;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Enrage
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Queen's pattern depends on whether the {{M2|Torch Head Amalgam}} is alive:

'''Opening (always):'''
# {{Int2|Queen|Puppet Strings}}
# {{Int2|Queen|You're Mine}}

'''While the Amalgam is alive:'''
: Repeats {{Int2|Queen|Burn Bright for Me}}.

'''After the Amalgam dies:'''
: If the Queen is currently using {{Int2|Queen|Burn Bright for Me}}, she immediately switches to {{Int2|Queen|Enrage}}, then enters the enraged loop:
# {{Int2|Queen|Off with Your Head}}
# {{Int2|Queen|Execution}}
# {{Int2|Queen|Enrage}}
# Back to {{Int2|Queen|Off with Your Head}}
* Keep in mind that Queen will have gained 2 {{BD2|Strength}} and that the player will likely be permanently {{BD2|Vulnerable}} from {{Int2|Queen|You're Mine}}, making these the actual damage amounts:
** {{Int2|Queen|Off with Your Head}}: 7x5 / {{Asc|9|9x5||2}}
** {{Int2|Queen|Execution}}: 25 / {{Asc|9|30||2}}

The Torch Head Amalgam follows a fixed sequence:
# {{Int2|Torch Head Amalgam|Strong Tackle}}
# {{Int2|Torch Head Amalgam|Tackle}}
# {{Int2|Torch Head Amalgam|Beam}}
# {{Int2|Torch Head Amalgam|Weak Tackle}}
# {{Int2|Torch Head Amalgam|Weak Tackle}}
# Back to {{Int2|Torch Head Amalgam|Beam}} (repeats steps 3-5)

== Notes ==
* After a {{KW2|Bound}} card is played, other Bound cards cannot be played that turn even with effects like {{KW2|Sly}} or a {{P2|Duplicator}}.
** Similarly, playing a {{KW2|Sly}} card that has {{KW2|Bound}} will prevent other Bound cards from being played.
* Bound cards duplicated by effects like {{R2|Music Box}} or {{C2|Dual Wield}} will also be bound.
* {{KW|Transform|Transforming|2}} a Bound card during battle will remove Bound from it, allowing it to be played freely.
* Bound cards are still unbound at the end of your turn even when {{KW2|Retain|Retained}}, allowing you to use cards such as {{C2|Well-Laid Plans}} to play other bound cards on a later turn.
* If a Bound card is played once, then returned to your hand in some way (ex. being redrawn), it still won't able to be played until end of turn.
* If the Torch Head Amalgam dies after its turn to an effect like {{BD2|Doom}}, the Queen will immediately switch intents to {{Int2|Queen|Off with Your Head}}, skipping the usual {{Int2|Queen|Enrage}} .
* If the Torch Head Amalgam is killed on Turn 2 or earlier, the Queen will not use {{Int2|Queen|Enrage}} on her first cycle.

== Trivia ==
* The Queen is based on {{M|The Collector}}, an Act 2 boss in the original Slay the Spire.
